title: Multi-Agent Discovery and Resource-Aware Autonomous Exploration of Scientific Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2608.22045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern scientific facilities and instruments generate datasets at scales that are difficult for individual researchers to discover, access, and explore. Although many datasets are publicly available, using them often requires familiarity with repository organization, data formats, multiresolution structures, and visualization parameters. We present WebVisus, a constrained and resource-aware multi-agent system for discovering and autonomously exploring remote, multiresolution scientific datasets. Given a natural-language research question, WebVisus identifies the user's intent and launches an autonomous exploration agent that examines slices, volumes, and timesteps while adapting data resolution and retrieval quality to available client memory and computational resources. This design supports progressive exploration without complete dataset downloads or manual configuration of low-level visualization parameters using natural languages.

translated_title: 多智能体发现与资源感知的科学数据集自主探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22045v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现代科学设施和仪器生成的数据集规模庞大，个体研究人员难以发现、访问和探索这些数据。尽管许多数据集是公开可用的，但使用它们通常需要熟悉存储库组织、数据格式、多分辨率结构和可视化参数。我们提出了WebVisus，一个受限且资源感知的多智能体系统，用于发现和自主探索远程、多分辨率的科学数据集。给定一个自然语言研究问题，WebVisus识别用户意图并启动一个自主探索智能体，该智能体检查切片、体积和时间步长，同时根据可用的客户端内存和计算资源调整数据分辨率和检索质量。这种设计支持渐进式探索，无需完整下载数据集或手动配置低级可视化参数，只需使用自然语言即可。
tldr: 本文提出WebVisus，一个资源感知的多智能体系统，能根据自然语言问题自主探索远程多分辨率科学数据集，并动态调整数据质量以适应资源限制，实现无需下载或手动配置的渐进式探索。
en_tdlr: This paper presents WebVisus, a resource-aware multi-agent system that autonomously explores remote multiresolution scientific datasets based on natural-language queries, dynamically adapting data quality to resource constraints for progressive exploration without downloads or manual configuration.
